## Details
### **SW-REQ-MLOG-001** — Raw IMU Record API

- **Description:** The mlog library shall accept raw IMU sample records and write them to non-volatile storage.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-001 and SW-REQ-SYS-022, raw IMU samples must be persisted to the SD card for post-flight analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-022
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-002** — Raw Barometer Record API

- **Description:** The mlog library shall accept raw barometer sample records and write them to non-volatile storage.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-001 and SW-REQ-SYS-022, raw barometer samples must be persisted to the SD card.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-022
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-003** — Raw GPS NMEA Record API

- **Description:** The mlog library shall accept raw GPS NMEA sentences and write them verbatim to non-volatile storage.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-024, raw GPS NMEA sentences must be preserved verbatim for post-flight reconstruction.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-024
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-004** — Navigation State Record API

- **Description:** The mlog library shall accept navigation state records and write them to non-volatile storage.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-022, navigation state estimates must be persisted to the SD card for post-flight analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-022
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-005** — AFM Phase Event Record API

- **Description:** The mlog library shall accept flight phase event records and write them to non-volatile storage.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-022, AFM flight phase events must be persisted to the SD card for post-flight analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-022
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-006** — GPS UTC Time Record API

- **Description:** The mlog library shall accept GPS UTC time records and write them to non-volatile storage.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-028, GPS UTC time records enable post-flight alignment of monotonic time to absolute UTC.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-028
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-007** — Per-Record Monotonic Microsecond Timestamp

- **Description:** The mlog library shall stamp every written record with a monotonic microsecond timestamp.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-026 and SW-REQ-SYS-027, every record (including per-sample raw records) must carry a monotonic microsecond stamp.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-026
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-008** — New Run Created at Initialization

- **Description:** The mlog library shall create a new log run on each initialization.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-025, each power-on must start a fresh log run distinct from prior runs.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-025
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-009** — Prior Run Preservation

- **Description:** The mlog library shall not overwrite or delete any prior log run.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-055, prior log runs must be preserved on the SD card until externally wiped.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-055
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-010** — Machine-Parseable Record Format

- **Description:** The mlog library shall write records in a machine-parseable format that identifies each record's type.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-023, log records must be machine-parseable; specific format details are deferred to design.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-023
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-011** — Write Failure Status Propagation

- **Description:** The mlog library shall return a failure status to the caller when the underlying SD write fails.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-035 and SW-REQ-SYS-060, SD write failures must be observable so callers can flag the SD unhealthy and continue.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-060
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-012** — Continue After Write Failure

- **Description:** The mlog library shall accept and attempt subsequent record writes after a prior write failure.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-035, the FSW must continue attempting SD writes after a write failure rather than halting.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-035
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-013** — POSIX and Pico2 Functional Equivalence

- **Description:** The mlog library shall provide functionally equivalent behavior on the POSIX and Pico2 builds.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-043, the POSIX build must be functionally equivalent to the Pico2 flight build for Trick simulation.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-014** — Deterministic Record Output

- **Description:** The mlog library shall produce identical written record byte sequences given identical input record sequences.
- **Rationale:** Per SW-REQ-SYS-044, deterministic output is required for repeatable Trick simulation runs and regression analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
